claim: Fresh derived-timing seed 990027 produced a legitimate lab-rival loss before any learned battle or training decision. The published recovery lane authenticates the loss, regains the semantic level floor, and completes two post-loss lessons before the clean source replay exhausts its bounded search for a safe final Weedle. Counted v95 remains unopened.

first_failure.observed_outcome: Squirtle fainted; the cartridge persisted battle result 1 and returned a healed level-five starter rather than a level-six victory state.

current_clean_source_failure.verified_progress: The authenticated loss branch completed its level-six recovery plus the first two post-loss Forest lessons before failing closed at the final safe-target search.

diagnosis.finding: The loss branch is not equivalent to the victory branch. Extra recovery battles advance encounter RNG, consume Tackle PP, and change the experience schedule. The level-aware K/W/W suffix is safe for the prey it accepts, but a single Forest search origin does not reliably supply its final low-level Weedle.
diagnosis.instrumented_probe: Non-promotable same-root probes mapped the boundary. Kakuna then level-four Weedle then level-three Caterpie leaves the starter level seven, healthy at 12/23 HP, unpoisoned, and slightly short of Bubble. Replacing the Caterpie with the available level-five Weedle reaches level eight and Bubble but leaves only 3/25 HP while poisoned. Tail Whip against Kakuna did not conserve Tackle because Harden cancelled the defense reduction. These probes monkeypatched runtime behavior outside the source provenance digest, so they are diagnosis only and not qualification evidence.
diagnosis.model_boundary: Every failure occurs inside the authored opening composite before the learned battle, switch-target, training-control, or trainee/venue heads receive authority. It is a teacher/executor reliability defect, not evidence that the learned models chose incorrectly.

next_gate.implementation: Move only the authenticated-loss catch-up lessons to Route 1, using bounded low-defense Pidgey/Rattata encounters near Viridian City. Prove a Viridian Center visit restores HP, status, and PP and returns to the exact route gate, then reuse the unchanged three-Kakuna Forest curriculum from that healed semantic floor.
